notes.title: Update and Apologies
notes.notes:
Once you beat the game in Normal mode, you can now show the timer
And, the difficulty of a certain part has been adjusted

I personally thought that part was the most fun, but now, I think it was not what the players expected from this game
I made this choice because I want to meet the demands of more players

I am very sorry to the people who have won this game in the previous version
The previous ranking will remain intact, please forgive me
